author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Fuel gauge dial: r20 rim, E mark left of centre, needle rising from a lower pivot toward the upper right as in the reference; features 8.6+ clear of the rim. The composition stays close to the rejected drawing because the rim leaves only an 11-unit disc for the features. No Lucide match (gauge built from circle + strokes).
omissions: The reference's larger E placed above centre and its long diagonal needle cannot fit 8 clear of the rim and of each other; the E is 16 tall (arms 8 apart) and the needle is 12 long.
